independent_review_summary.implementation_status: The candidate contains a real packaged model and executes synthetic forward/backward and inference probes, but it does not satisfy several explicit frozen architecture clauses and its evidence packet overclaims unexecuted properties.
independent_review_summary.verification_status: The frozen Verifier primarily validates self-declared JSON fields and synthetic mutations of that same JSON. It does not independently derive the critical claims from the exact implementation, runtime receipts, or code-level adversarial mutations.

blocking_findings.why_it_matters: The frozen verifier accepts booleans, numbers and syntactically valid SHA-256 strings supplied by the Executor evidence builder. Its protected cases mutate those same declarations rather than mutating or intercepting the executable CARE-ASE graph, loss, sampler, checkpoint or inference paths. Consequently a canned packet can claim stock parity, module authority, no-T2 safety, exact resume, fair evaluation and hard-negative binding without the verifier recomputing any of them. This directly violates the contract requirement that static or canned receipts must not pass without real execution.
required_repair: Replace declaration-only acceptance for critical categories with independent executable checks bound to the exact integration commit and source manifest.
Recompute file and receipt hashes from tracked bytes; verify command, stdout and stderr hashes against actual artifacts rather than only checking 64-character syntax.
Add independent graph/topology checks for the exact SliceExtentHead, edema residual dilation blocks and injury-classifier initialization.
Add executable intervention tests that disable or perturb each required module and verify the intended final logit changes.
Add real no-T2 and mixed-batch hook/gradient checks, real loss-path checks, exact checkpoint save/reload/resume checks and single-tile versus forced-multi-tile inference checks.
Convert protected known-bad fixtures into code/runtime mutations or monkeypatches that would pass if the implementation had the corresponding downgrade; do not merely flip evidence booleans.
required_regression_evidence: A packet with every declaration set to the passing value but missing underlying receipts must fail.
A packet whose receipt hash does not match the tracked receipt bytes must fail.
Replacing the extent implementation with the current Conv3d/alias shortcut must fail an exact topology test.
Removing residual addition from any edema dilation block must fail.
Changing the injury classifier initialization away from the stock class-4/class-5 mean must fail.
At least one protected fixture per critical category must modify executable behavior and be rejected after an actual forward/backward or inference run.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not add more self-declared booleans or hash-shaped placeholder strings.
Do not let the Executor regenerate or edit protected verifier fixtures.
Do not weaken the frozen contract or mark synthetic JSON mutation coverage as executable implementation coverage.

blocking_findings.why_it_matters: The frozen contract requires two independent quarter-scale SliceExtentHead modules that first compute masked average and masked maximum over H/W and then apply a Conv1d(C,64,3)-GroupNorm-SiLU-Conv1d stack with separate presence and area outputs. The candidate instead uses per-voxel Conv3d heads; scar presence is aliased to scar_quarter_occupancy, and no required Conv1d or GroupNorm extent network exists. This is a direct architecture downgrade, not a naming difference.
required_repair: Implement distinct scar and edema SliceExtentHead modules with the exact frozen Conv1d and GroupNorm topology.
Feed quarter-scale features through masked H/W average and masked maximum before the 1D sequence network.
Keep scar extent independent from the scar proposal occupancy head.
Preserve separate presence and area validity, full-case targets, zero contribution for invalid/padded slices and the single post-aggregation global bias path.
Update training and inference to call the same canonical extent-statistics and extent-head implementation.
required_regression_evidence: Module introspection proves two distinct extent heads and the exact Conv1d/GN layer sequence.
Parameter identity proves scar extent presence is not the scar proposal occupancy parameter.
Intervention of each extent head changes only its intended pathology final logits after the ramp is active.
All-invalid and partial-H/W slices produce exactly zero bias, loss and gradient.
Single-tile and forced-multi-tile full-volume paths match within the frozen tolerance.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not relabel the existing Conv3d proposal/context heads as SliceExtentHead.
Do not preserve the scar occupancy alias.
Do not satisfy the check only through evidence metadata.

blocking_findings.why_it_matters: The edema dilation paths are sequential convolution blocks whose outputs are projected as evidence; they contain no residual identity/addition despite the frozen requirement for real dilation-1/2/4 residual blocks in the full edema path. In addition, edema_injury is a fresh default-initialized Conv3d and is not initialized from the shape-compatible mean of stock class-4 and class-5 classifier rows. Both are explicit frozen initialization/topology requirements.
required_repair: Implement true residual dilation blocks at dilations 1, 2 and 4 with an explicit identity or shape-compatible projection and residual addition.
Ensure all three residual outputs causally enter the full-resolution edema reconstruction path.
Initialize the injury classifier from the shape-compatible mean of stock class-4 and class-5 rows and record exact byte/value comparison evidence.
Keep the boundary path learnable and independently supervised.
required_regression_evidence: Topology hooks prove each dilation block executes a residual addition.
Zeroing or bypassing each dilation residual changes z_pure_edema and the final class competition on a T2-present probe.
The initialized injury classifier matches the expected stock-row mean before any probe update.
The two-backward gradient probe reaches dilation upstream parameters after the named projections become nonzero.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not call a parallel convolution output a residual block without an addition.
Do not use an arbitrary random injury head and assert initialization through metadata.
Do not reintroduce a local crop, hard ROI or second complete backbone.

blocking_findings.why_it_matters: The forward/backward probe uses a random tensor and optimizes mean(z_scar)+mean(z_pure_edema), yielding a negative scalar that is not the frozen CARE-ASE total loss and does not exercise labels, eligibility masks, loss denominators, reliable-edema supervision, mixed-batch no-T2 behavior or sampler outputs. The inference probe also uses random data with a patch equal to the entire volume, so it does not establish real-case preprocessing, forced multi-tile equivalence, global-bias single application or deployment loading. The evidence builder then hardcodes many unexecuted claims as true.
required_repair: Run zero-credit probes on at least one actual train-only Dataset501 case for scar and one eligible T2-present case for edema, plus a mixed batch containing a no-T2 row.
Invoke the canonical target construction, sampler descriptor and complete frozen total-loss function; report every loss value, eligibility count and denominator.
Perform the two-backward projection/upstream gradient test using the real total loss rather than a mean-logit surrogate.
Run actual no-T2 hooks and parameter-gradient accounting in a mixed batch.
Run canonical full-volume inference on a real case twice: one single-tile configuration and one forced multi-tile configuration, with global bias active and exact comparison.
Regenerate evidence fields only from machine-derived probe outputs.
required_regression_evidence: Receipts identify train-only case IDs, split hash, preprocessing grid, availability and target-cache hashes without exposing protected image data.
All required loss terms are finite, included in the total and report nonzero or correctly excluded denominators.
No-T2 rows have zero edema calls, supervision, loss denominator contribution and edema parameter gradient in the same mixed-batch run.
Single-tile and forced-multi-tile outputs agree under the frozen semantics.
The evidence builder fails closed when any required real-case receipt is absent.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not count random tensors or a mean-logit surrogate as real training-case loss evidence.
Do not hardcode passing booleans from source-string presence.
Do not perform formal optimizer steps or count these probes as training.

blocking_findings.why_it_matters: The hard-negative record names synthetic_zero_credit_no_case_selection and fills the required mask, coordinate, checkpoint and grid fields with hashes of unrelated generated artifacts rather than a canonical OOF prediction bound to a real train case. The evidence packet also claims exact checkpoint/resume continuity, self-contained deployment and fair full-volume evaluation, but its receipt manifest contains only synthetic forward/backward and inference probes and no checkpoint-resume or evaluator receipt. These claims are therefore unbound.
required_repair: Bind at least one real canonical OOF hard-negative example to case ID, split/fold, prediction artifact, actual stock checkpoint SHA, preprocessed grid SHA, mask SHA and coordinate descriptor SHA; record requested and resolved sampler categories.
Add an exact schema-v4 save/reload/resume probe that compares the next optimizer step, scheduler/ramp, optimizer state and all RNG/cursor states against an uninterrupted control.
Add deployment-load evidence from tracked code plus explicitly declared relocatable assets.
Add a fair evaluator smoke receipt proving identical case population, TTA, decode and metric interface for CARE and baseline.
Have the Verifier independently resolve and hash all referenced artifacts.
required_regression_evidence: Synthetic or unrelated hashes cannot satisfy the hard-negative validator.
Cross-fold, contract-drift, missing-asset and altered-RNG resume fixtures fail closed.
The next-step output/state after reload matches the uninterrupted control.
Evaluator receipt lists all required metrics and proves shared case/TTA/decode population.
All new receipts are included in the implementation fingerprint and runtime receipt manifest.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not use hash-shaped placeholders or hashes of architecture/registry files as OOF bindings.
Do not assert checkpoint/resume or evaluation properties without executable receipts.
Do not access outer data or perform model selection.
